Horrible customer services. Lying to customers.
Apr 2020
At 13:56 April 25th I called 028-62636688 to book a table for 2 at 19:00. Due to Covid-19 I specifically asked the staff who handled the call whether the restaurant has re-opened and I was positively confirmed. I told him that I would use my Marriott card and I wanted a table near windows reserved. When I arrived at 19:00 the restaurant was closed and the whole 9th floor was completely dark. What the actual f***? Spoke to the receptionist on ground floor about the incident and they called some operators or whatever and they told me that there was no booking at Bamboo Chic for the night. So now I'm a liar? Such great customer service for a 5* hotel!!!

Service
Review collected in partnership with this restaurant 
Written April 25, 2020
Jan Willem
Dear Mr. Khanh,

I hope you are doing well and thank you for leaving your feedback here on TA. On behalf of the Food and Beverage team, I wish to sincerely apologize for the misunderstanding with your booking. Due to Covid19 pandemic, we had to close the restaurants for the last months, in order to be compliant with the governmental restrictions. Therefore at this stage, we have only opened our lobby lounge, since it consists of less then 20 seats. Here we do serve a la carte menu and we do accept your CM membership card. Furthermore, we are in the process of opening our lounge at the 22nd floor, with great views over the city, where we also will serve a a la cart menu, up to 20 people and do accept your CM membership. 

Once again I do apologize for this misunderstanding as written above, and I would love to invite you back at our hotel, to experience the lounge on the 22nd floor. We will have a great view and table next to window available. We will make sure that you will have a memorable experience with our food and beverage services.

In the meantime, please feel free to reach out to me directly if I can be of further assistance to you or if you like to make a future booking and experience our lounge at the 22nd floor. 

Once again, we apologize for this experience and thank you for sharing your feedback with us.

Best Regards,

Jan Willem Hommersom
Director of Food and Beverage
0946 424 026
johannes.hommersom@lemeridienhotels.com
